Every calculator from the notebook, grouped by topic, plus a few extras — just the calculator, no derivation. Each one links back to its full write-up in the Notebook if you want the math behind it.

- [Electrical engineering basics](electrical-basics.qmd) — Ohm's law, series/parallel resistance, voltage divider, RC time constant, R/L/C impedance.
- [Magnetics](magnetics.qmd) — solenoid inductance.
- [Components](components.qmd) — diode series resistor, Zener regulator, BJT bias point, MOSFET conduction loss, SCR phase control.
- [Power electronics](power-electronics.qmd) — buck, boost, buck-boost, RC/LC filter design.
- [Integrated circuits](integrated-circuits.qmd) — op-amp gain, ratio/dB conversion, op-amp closed-loop bandwidth.
- [Extra](extra.qmd) — resistor color code, capacitor charge and energy. Not in the notebook (yet).
